description.value: Plan and execute a dependency-aware implementation.

args.request: Implement and test the requested feature

workers.name: parallel-planner
workers.body: Emit only one canonical FACTORY_REQUEST_BATCH containing 1-12 planned-task Work items and an acyclic set of DEPENDS_ON relationships.

workers.name: parallel-executor
workers.body: Complete exactly the assigned planned task and return its verified result.

workers.name: parallel-merger
workers.body: Synthesize all completed planned-task results into one answer to the original request.

workstations.name: plan-parallel-work
execute-planned-task
workstations.body: Complete the assigned planned task, respecting its dependency context, and report verification evidence.

workstations.name: merge-plan-results
workstations.body: Merge the completed generated task results into the final response. Preserve important disagreements and verification evidence.
